CLOUD DESIGN-REVISION seat (revision 2) for the combined CI design (group R10-CI-LAYOUT) of tvofi/heatpump_optimizer. Never send push notifications.
Setup: `git fetch --unshallow --tags origin`. Toolchain on PATH. Run heavy jobs in the background with Monitor.
Inputs: revision 1 `probe/design-ci-rev1` (485ae940), round-2 review `probe/design-ci-review2` (d63cbe42, REVIEW.md + ev/, verdict revise), round-1 review `probe/design-ci-review` (f7b28312). Read them in full, plus CLAUDE.md, judge.md, ci-autofix.md, gate-scoping.md and orchestrator.md from origin/main.
Task: resolve exactly the five items in the round-2 review's 'What would turn this into approve', soundly and with re-run evidence: N1, re-runs (refresh, gate-sweep.yml) must never cancel live runs, by design and in the simulator, plus M-5; N2, fix gate_sim.py's double finish so concurrent re-judgements cannot defer on each other, re-score the three readings and state the 50-attempt bound; item 5, wait on the code-scanning check run, or a correctly keyed analyses query (refs/pull/N/merge), and measure the lag for U6; N3, step order in unitcheck2's static half, with Q1 in its self-test; N4, add prepr.sh:935-938 and entities.py:25883-25893 to section 9. Leave everything else in revision 1 as it is, unless a fix forces a change, and if one does, say so. Add a `## Round-2 item <id>` section for each item to RESPONSE.md.
Return: commit the revised DESIGN-P1.md, DESIGN-P2.md, measure/ and RESPONSE.md, and push ONLY `refs/heads/probe/design-ci-rev2`. No PRs, comments or workflow edits on real branches. No host paths in any text. Never work around a hook or refusal; report it.
